# MPLOYEDIN
> AI-Powered International Recruitment Platform

MPLOYEDIN is a dual-sided recruitment marketplace connecting employers worldwide
with top talent using AI-powered candidate matching and data-driven hiring tools.

## Public Pages

- /en/: Platform homepage
- /en/jobs: Browse active job listings worldwide
- /en/blog: Recruitment insights, job market trends, hiring guides
- /en/faq: Frequently asked questions about the platform
- /en/about: About MPLOYEDIN
- /en/contact: Contact information

## Arabic (RTL) versions available at /ar/
